column3: Adapt the garden composition for portrait and small screens
column4: Added a portrait layout that stacks the tree, bed and tools down the garden, plus larger objects and less decoration on phones. The bird and snail positions are calculated from the tree and stone so they stay perched when the scene changes shape.

column3: Draw the apple, pear and strawberry beside the basket
column4: Added the three fruits as separate SVG objects next to the woven basket under the tree. Each fruit has its own ID and a data-category so it can be given a sound family later.

column3: Draw the bird, butterfly and snail
column4: Added the three animals as separate SVG objects. The bird's feet line up with the bare tree branch, the butterfly hovers above the flowers and the snail rests on a flat stone.

column3: Draw the gardening tools around the planting bed
column4: Added the watering can, hand trowel, rake and flowerpot as separate SVG objects with their own IDs. They use a thicker dark outline than the scenery so they stand out by shape.

column3: Add the foreground grass strip and small garden details
column4: Added a low grass strip along the bottom edge with pebbles, fallen leaves, seedlings and lawn tufts. The foreground layer sits beneath the object layer so it can never hide an object.

column3: Add the vegetable bed, stepping stones and flowers
column4: Drew the raised bed, stepping stones, flowers, leafy plants and fruit basket as reusable SVGs. They sit in their own decoration layer around the edges so the middle of the lawn stays open.

column3: Add the sky, hills, fence, hedge and tree
column4: Drew the clouds, distant hills, lawn, hedge shrubs, picket fence and tree as separate SVG files. A shared SVG displacement filter gives each outline the same hand-cut edge.

column3: Set up the garden page and responsive layout
column4: Created the page, colour tokens and a paper-grain texture. The garden keeps a fixed aspect ratio that switches to a taller shape on portrait screens, so percentage positions stay aligned.
